headline: A 2021 Senate resolution would have blocked a proposed U.S. weapons sale to Saudi Arabia, but the Senate did not advance it.
what_it_does: The resolution would have prohibited a proposed foreign military sale of specified defense articles to Saudi Arabia. It is a joint resolution of disapproval, a process that lets Congress try to stop an arms sale the executive branch has proposed. The official summary does not list the specific weapons involved.

who_it_affects.how: It would not have been able to buy the specified defense articles through this proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense contractors that would have supplied the specified defense articles
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the proposed sale of those items to Saudi Arabia.
